FFDAGGERHEART.Label: Daggerheart
FFDAGGERHEART.NeedsCore: FastFighting Daggerheart needs the FastFighting module (the core) to be active.
FFDAGGERHEART.CoreTooOld: FastFighting Daggerheart needs a newer FastFighting Core. Update FastFighting.
FFDAGGERHEART.CoreUntested: FastFighting Daggerheart hasn't been tried with FastFighting Core API {major}; some things may not work.

Spotlight.Gm: the spotlight swings to the GM: {name}
Spotlight.Fear: the GM spends a Fear to spotlight {name} too ({fear} left)

DeathMove.BlazeNote: Blaze of Glory: one last action, then death
DeathMove.RiskDies: Risk It All: Hope {hope}, Fear {fear}, and death
DeathMove.RiskLives: Risk It All: Hope {hope}, Fear {fear}, back up with {n} Hit Points
DeathMove.RiskAll: Risk It All: Hope {hope}, Fear {fear}, matching: fully healed, Stress cleared
DeathMove.AvoidScar: Avoid Death: out cold, and a scar (Hope die {n})
DeathMove.Finished: struck while out cold: Hope {hope}, Fear {fear}, and death
DeathMove.HangsOn: struck while out cold: Hope {hope}, Fear {fear}, and it hangs on

Plan.Title: Daggerheart
Plan.Hint: The GM's Fear going in, and how freely it's spent on more adversaries.
Plan.FearHint: The GM's Fear going in; Do it For Real Now writes back what's left.
Plan.SpendingHint: Each GM turn one adversary acts; each Fear spent adds one more.
Plan.sparingHint: One more adversary only while the GM holds over 4 Fear.
Plan.steadyHint: One more adversary while the GM holds over 1 Fear.
Plan.freeHint: As many more adversaries as there's Fear for.

loreBoost.Name: Lore-Collector advantage
loreBoost.Hint: How much likelier a Lore-Collector's next roll at a foe is after a successful Analyze or Perceive. Default 2.4×.

tiedStopsSpells.Name: Tied up stops spells
tiedStopsSpells.Hint: Daggerheart doesn't say which spells need free hands. On: a tied-up creature can't cast until it's free. Off: it can.

FFDAGGERHEART.Helped: helped (a d6 on their next roll)

Sprint.Missed: tries to sprint (Agility, {note}) and gets no farther than Close range
Sprint.Adversary: closes in, up to Very Far range
